description: Starts one run of an automation now, as its manual trigger does, with payload as the trigger’s data. The automation then acts as it was built to, which can include sending WhatsApp messages to customers; those messages are final once sent. Each start needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it starts the run. Returns the run, which the run tools follow.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

name: run_automation
title: Start an automation by hand
